result.title: A Proxy-Based Method for Measuring Racial Disparities in~Text-to-Image~Generators
result.summary: We present an automated method for auditing text-to-image generators for representational bias against ground-truth demographic benchmarks. Our approach adapts the racial proxy variables used in U.S. antidiscrimination law to provide a fine-grained comparative analysis of variations in racial representation in generated images. We classify each generated image by race and then compare the model's distribution to publicly available demographic benchmark data to identify patterns of over- and under-representation. We also measure skin tone using CIELAB values and calculate cosine similarity amongst groups of images in order to capture biases that don't show up in demographic comparisons such as differences in image quality across races and skin tones. We report on experiments testing three models (Imagen 4 Fast, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo, and Flux Schnell) using three categories of proxies (geographic, occupational, and surname) and 50 variants within each category. We find notable variation across the models as well as by proxy category. For example, Imagen 4 Fast overrepresents white classified images more than the other models tested and produces images with lighter, more homogeneous skin tones. Imagen 4 Fast also had the largest representational disparity for Black demographics among surname and geographical prompts. Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo produces results that overall diverge most from census data but yield the most diverse range of skin tones. Our method yields a generalizable and legally-grounded auditing tool that surfaces detailed information about model outputs without relying on implicit normative definitions of fairness.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出一种自动审计方法，借助美国反歧视法中的种族代理变量，将文本到图像模型生成图像的种族分布与人口基准对比，并结合 CIELAB 肤色度量与组间余弦相似度，分析三个模型在不同代理类别下的表征偏差。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题为图像生成的公平性审计与人口统计偏差度量，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、证据获取或停止决策；组间余弦相似度虽属表示几何，但用于衡量生成图像质量差异，与 latent 推理状态的内容、深度或缓存结构无具体可借鉴联系。
